title: Four Kind Beats at the Tangled Stall
youtube_title: Four Kind Beats at the Tangled Stall | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Naming turns keeps a busy stall from tangling every job at once.
summary: Labels, peels, and the tablecloth all arrive at once, so Hana, Giorgio, and Laleh count a shared beat for each job until the stall stands ready.
